recommendations.speaker: Mange, Gäst
recommendations.reasoning: New game Crossell is a major hit - top 10 grossing in USA with exceptional retention and highest ARPU among all MAG games. Stock currently has 7% dividend yield, debt-free with 100M cash (EV 250M). Moving from 2 to 3 major games creates significant growth potential. Q4 comparison against very weak prior year could drive re-rating.
recommendations.quote: Nu har den börjat värderas upp men jag tror att det kommer att kunna bli en betydligt bättre utveckling när man ser Crossell fortsätta utvecklas positivt. Jag tycker att den här action känns, jag tror att den kommer att ha en rejäl uppvärdering faktiskt kommande kvartalen

summary: Market Makers discusses several special situation opportunities: Coinshares' potential SPAC arbitrage, Integrum's bid speculation, and Ceotronics' strong earnings report. Main focus is on Mag Interactive whose new game Crossell is showing exceptional performance in USA markets, potentially driving a re-rating of the stock. The episode also includes an interview with VEF about emerging market fintech investments in Brazil, India and Mexico.
key_takeaways: Coinshares SPAC transaction creates 33% valuation gap worth monitoring
Integrum bid arbitrage offers short-term opportunity with high success probability
Ceotronics reports exceptional quarter but still trades at discount to defense sector peers
Mag Interactive's new game Crossell is a major success story creating growth catalyst
VEF provides exposure to emerging market fintech through Swedish-listed investment company
